result_or_proposition.definition: months=3 denotes Q3, 6 first six months, 9 first nine months. Fiscal years are 2026 for economic periods in 2025 and 2025 for periods in 2024. Earnings margins use total revenue. For Q3 and nine-month periods, reconstruct GAAP operating income as revenue less cost of sales less SG&A. Reconstructed adjusted operating income is reconstructed GAAP operating income plus the signed PhonePe SBC, legal and reorganization adjustments. Reconstructed adjusted constant-currency operating income is reconstructed adjusted operating income plus the reported adjusted-income currency bridge. For each fiscal year, every first-six-month flow and reconstructed stage equals its nine-month amount less its Q3 amount before calculating margins. Each margin is 100 times its matching reconstructed income divided by reported total revenue. Reported income amounts are comparison observations, not inputs that restart a later reconstructed stage.

reserve_bridge

Changes are June less May stocks, not transaction flows. Reserve change is (June cash + June government debt) minus (May cash + May government debt). Use these component sums for the coverage change as well. Keep reported reserve fair values independent, with component sums less reported fair values as the reserve_coverage residuals. Signature lags are calendar days, not known publication delays.

stock_bridge

Use January 30 to February 10 and February 10 to February 27. Each stock is the reported observation in reserve_observations. Treasury change uses treasury_fair_value_usd, asset change uses reported_assets_usd, and cash, repo and token changes use cash_usd, repo_fair_value_usd and redeemable_tokens. Changes are current less prior stocks, with surplus change equal to asset change less redeemable-token change. This reported-stock basis is separate from the holdings-based reconstruction in qualified_coverage and treasury_valuation. Preserve any difference between reported and reconstructed values.

corporate_bridge

For each year, segment_sum_usd_million is summed segment adjusted EBITDA. total_adjusted_ebitda_usd_million is reconstructed as that sum plus the signed corporate_cost_usd_million. The EBITDA residual is reconstructed total adjusted EBITDA less platform.adjusted_ebitda_usd_million. The bookings residual is summed segment bookings less platform.bookings_usd_million, and the revenue residual is summed segment revenue less platform.revenue_usd_million. total_ebitda_to_bookings_pct is 100 times reconstructed total adjusted EBITDA divided by summed segment bookings. Reported platform totals remain independent reconciliation observations even when they disagree with reconstructed totals.
